jobs.occupation: Verantwortliche Elektrofachkraft Offshore-Windkraftanlagen (m/f/d) (Techniker/in - Windenergietechnik/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
jobs.description: Imagine a future where you play a key role in ensuring electrical safety across our offshore substations and wind turbines while helping us push the boundaries of safe, efficient, and reliable offshore operations.Join us in this role where you’ll take independent ownership of electrical safety within your area of responsibility, overseeing electrical installations on wind turbines in our German wind farms. You’ll combine your deep technical expertise with on-site presence—both at your permanent base in Norddeich and offshore—in order to guide colleagues, strengthen procedures, and ensure safe systems of work.Welcome to HV and Transmission GERYou’ll be part of HV and Transmission GER, where you and your colleagues will ensure electrical safety governance and operational support across high-voltage infrastructure in our German offshore wind farms. Your team is dedicated to managing safety-critical systems, uplifting operational standards, and sharing expertise across the organisation.As a team, we collaborate closely, support one another’s development, and bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset to every challenge.You’ll play an important role in:- preparing and reviewing risk assessments for offshore electrical work- supporting the selection, training, and supervision of Authorised Persons, electricians, and electrically instructed persons offshore- contributing to the qualification and supervision of contractors in the offshore electrical environment- developing, implementing, and improving maintenance plans for offshore electrical installations- coordinating multiple employers involved in offshore electrical activities- planning, organising, delivering, and documenting electrical safety training- implementing, strengthening, and regularly reviewing the Wind Turbine Safety Rules (WTSR) and Orsted Electrical Safety Rules (OESR)- assuming designated roles within the Safe Systems of Work, such as Authorising Engineer, Authorising Officer, or Training Mentor- auditing work processes before offshore deployment.To succeed in the role, you:- have completed a degree within electrical engineering, or equivalent- bring strong expertise within electrical safety, including standards, laws, and regulations- demonstrate technical leadership competence- offer switching experience in high-voltage environments above 20 kV- communicate confidently in both English and German at B2 level or higher- are comfortable using IT systems, including Microsoft Office, SAP, and AI tools- ideally have a qualification for live working, experience with wind turbines, or prior responsibility as an electrician- meet the minimum competency requirements within your onboarding timeframe, supported by our learning and development processes.**Country-specific requirements: **fulfil the requirements of a responsible electrician (vEFK) according to VDE 1000-10.Please note that in this role you will be mainly working in our office in Norddeich from Monday to Friday. An important part of the role will be an inspection of plants and the professional guidance of the electricians. This requires partial work offshore (20-40%) in a 7- or 14-day shift pattern.Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.Shape the future with usSend your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

About Fishlabs Fishlabs GmbH, headquartered in Hamburg, has been delivering outstanding video games since 2004, consistently expanding its portfolio of shipped titles. In December 2013, the studio joined Plaion (formerly known as Koch Media), a world-leading developer, publisher, and distributor of digital entertainment products. As part of Plaion and alongside the various sister studios across the globe, FISHLABS keeps creating stunning immersive experiences that inspire millions of players worldwide. The 70-strong, multinational team of FISHLABS has assembled a broad portfolio of award-winning own IPs as well as co-development titles and keeps at the forefront of gaming.  We are looking to continue building on our success with humble but talented and creative people who have a passion for making outstanding games and want to be at the forefront of gaming. Are you ready for the challenge? Join us! This is going to be a thrilling ride. Your Mission Looking after the front office: You are the contact person for our colleagues and visitors Receiving and sending mail, general correspondence, as well as filing and office organization are part of your daily tasks Administration and ordering of office supplies (except IT hardware/software, which our IT department orders itself), merch items, drinks and food Checking incoming and outgoing invoices and being the contact person for suppliers Coordination with the property management (repairs and maintenance in the office) and external service providers such as cleaning services Organizing events (e.g. team events, Christmas parties, etc.) and travel planning. Looking after our company apartment (move-in and move-out dates, communication with the property management/cleaning service) Office onboarding for new employees We are looking for someone to work part-time in the mornings, on-site in our office, 5 days a week (~20 hours) Your Skillset Completed apprenticeship or equivalent professional experience At least 2-4 years of professional experience in office management A desire to work in an international environment Excellent command of German and English (English is the company language) Proficiency in standard office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) A proactive, independent, and structured approach to work, a hands-on mentality, enthusiasm, and a drive to move things forward Strong communication skills, openness to feedback, and self-confidence The ability to maintain an overview and a positive, friendly demeanor, even during hectic periods Flexibility in responding to various situations and the ability to spontaneously adjust priorities Strong organizational skills and the ability to work effectively, even under pressure Mission Support We are just as passionate about our games as we are about their creators (Could that be you?!). Your job comes with personal responsibility, freedom and short decision-making routes. And most importantly - A motivated, international team full of fellow gamers. The studio is located in a bright, modern office, right in the center of Hamburg. With a selection of benefits for all our staff: Including discounted gym membership, fresh fruit and a variety of free drinks. A healthy work-life balance is important to you? For us too! That's why we are also awarded as a family-friendly workplace. Coming from abroad? No problem! We also offer relocation packages. Get In Touch! Did we spark your interest? We are looking forward to your application. Simply click on the button below and apply by uploading your CV. If you have any further documents which you think might be worth sharing to underline your background and talents, we are happy to receive them as well. If you have questions regarding the application just drop us an e-mail at hr@fishlabs.de. An application via our online tool is preferred.
